data: Apple's diluted earnings per share were $7.46 in fiscal 2025 (ended September 27, 2025), up from $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (ended September 28, 2024). That is an increase of about 22.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was roughly $112.0 billion, compared with $93.7 billion in fiscal 2024, a gain of about 19.5%. EPS grew faster than net income because share repurchases reduced the diluted share count. I'm giving these figures from memory rather than from a filing I pulled just now, so check them against Apple's fiscal 2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
